title: Boudreau's Caricatures
content: Canadian caricaturistDavid Boudreauhas worked for the big studios such as Disney, Warner Bros., Meatball Animation and Dreamworks. He iscurrently freelancingand adding to his portrait portfolio.Clockwise from upper left: Norman Rockwell, Jean Giraud (Moebius), Andy Serkis (Gollum), and—hey, that's me.-------Thanks, David!Check outthe rest of David Boudreau's caricatures:David Boudreau on Facebook
